_readme: Download caps enforced by `npm run check-budget` (tools/check-budget.mjs). Sizes are MB (1 MB = 1048576 bytes), measured uncompressed, so real transfers with gzip are smaller. Raise a cap only on purpose, in the same change that needs it, and say why in the commit.
_lakeStage: The expanded Lake America props and PBR textures compress from 25.65 MB to 7.83 MB. Allow 8 MB for this stage while preserving the 80 MB total and 35 MB first-fight caps.
